setup.title: Configure Privacy Module
setup.description: Tell us your regulatory coverage, DPA stance, and internal norms — all skills will then auto-adapt.
setup.practiceSettingPlaceholder: e.g. In-house legal / Mid-size firm / Internet company privacy team
regulations: Children's Personal Information Online Protection Provisions
setup.dataResidencyPlaceholder: e.g. China mainland only / Multi-region deployment
setup.dpaNotesDesc: Briefly describe your DPA negotiation stance (audit rights, breach notification timeline, sub-processing, cross-border transfers, deletion, liability caps, etc.). Leave blank to fill in later.
setup.dpaNotesPlaceholder:
As processor: accept ISO 27001 / MLPS Level 3 audit reports…
As controller: require vendor to provide sub-processor list, 72-hour breach notification…
setup.piaTriggerPlaceholder: e.g. Processing of sensitive personal information / automated decision-making / cross-border data transfer (PIPL Art. 55)
setup.dsarSystems: DSAR System Inventory (separate with commas or newlines)
setup.dsarSystemsPlaceholder: Production DB, analytics platform, customer service tickets, CRM, email marketing, logs, backups
setup.dsarSlaPlaceholder: e.g. Within 15 business days (PIPL Art. 45 'timely'; internal policy is stricter)
setup.seedNote: You can add seed files (processing rules, DPA templates, reference PIAs) later on the Settings page. This step is skipped in Quick Setup mode.
setup.seedSkip: No uploads for now — click "Next" to continue.
setup.readyDesc: Click "Finish Setup" and the system will generate your practice profile based on your answers, used to personalize all skills.

triage.title: Processing Activity Triage
triage.description: Describe a personal information processing activity. AI determines whether a PIA is required, whether Art. 55 PIPL mandatory assessment is triggered, or whether it can proceed — and checks for processing rule conflicts.
triage.promptPlaceholder: Data categories, data subjects, purpose, new collection?, third-party vendors?, automated decision-making?, deployment context…

dpa.title: DPA Review (Bidirectional)
dpa.description: Review a data processing agreement. Auto-identifies whether you are the processor or controller, checks clause-by-clause against your playbook, with six-dimension risk ratings and revision suggestions.
dpa.subjectPlaceholder: e.g. A cloud service provider / A corporate client
dpa.promptPlaceholder: Paste DPA text or key clauses (audit rights, breach notification, sub-processing, cross-border transfer, deletion, liability…)
dpa.directionEntrusted: We are the Processor (client sent us their DPA)
dpa.directionHandler: We are the Controller (reviewing a vendor's DPA)

pia.title: Personal Information Protection Impact Assessment (PIA)
pia.description: Generate a PIA in your internal format: lawful basis (PIPL Art. 13), sensitive personal information (Art. 28–30), cross-border transfer (Art. 38), risks & mitigations, data subject rights (Art. 44–50), and recommendations.
pia.promptPlaceholder: What problem does the feature solve? What PI fields are involved? New collection? Who can access? Storage region? Retention period? Third-party sharing?…

gap.title: Regulatory Gap Analysis
gap.description: Compare a newly issued or amended regulation against current processing rules and practices. Output a gap checklist and a remediation plan with owners and deadlines.
gap.subjectPlaceholder: e.g. Measures for the Standard Contract for Cross-Border Transfer of Personal Information
gap.promptPlaceholder: Paste the regulation text or summary, or describe the regulatory changes to compare against…

policyMonitor.title: Processing Rule Monitor
policyMonitor.description: Scan saved outputs for processing rule drift, or run direct queries against proposed new practices (across surfaces: website policy / CMP / app labels / in-product consent / industry notices).
policyMonitor.sweepHint: Sweep mode compares analysis outputs since the last sweep against processing rule commitments, identifies must-update vs. suggested-update items, and updates the last-sweep timestamp.
policyMonitor.queryPlaceholder: e.g. We want to start using behavioral data for personalized onboarding emails… (data / purpose / vendors / subjects / new disclosure?)

dsar.title: Data Subject Rights Requests
dsar.description: Minimize personal information when creating records — use reference numbers instead of real names. After creation, open the detail page to draft acknowledgment and substantive response letters.
